english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a number, amount, or division is approximate.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying a quantity is approximately a particular amount.
Use this for a general estimate or approximation, especially before a quantity, time, or description.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 koi3 luk6 dim2 dou3

examples.english: This restaurant has approximately sixty seats.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳大概有六十個位。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 daai6 koi3 jau5 luk6 sap6 go3 wai2
daai6 koi3 sap6 go3 jan4 wui5 lei4

english.note: Use this when you want to emphasize an approximate degree of probability or uncertainty.
Use this for a probable guess when sounding somewhat less definite than 應該.

examples.english: We will presumably only get back at around eight.
examples.jyutping: daai6 koi3 baat3 dim2 sin1 faan2 dou3

examples.english: I will probably get back around three.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 koi3 saam1 dim2 sin1 faan1 dou3
